description: Invite or remove users from a room.

culture.description: The languages to use for the invitation.

filters.description: The filters to apply to the room security info.

items.description:
The fields to include in the response.

members.access - The access rights type.
members.sharedTo - The user who has the access to the specified file.
members.isLocked - Specifies if the access right is locked or not.
members.isOwner - Specifies if the user is an owner of the specified file or not.
members.canEditAccess - Specifies if the user can edit the access to the specified file or not.
members.subjectType - The subject type.
warning - The warning message.
error - The error type.

invitations.description: The invitations or removals to perform.

items.description: The invitation or removal of a user. Must contain either User ID or User Email.

access.description:
The access level to grant to the user. May vary depending on the type of room.

0 - None. No access to the room.
2 - Viewer. File viewing.
5 - Reviewer. Operations with existing files: viewing, reviewing, commenting.
6 - Commenter. Operations with existing files: viewing, commenting.
7 - Form filler. Form fillers can fill out forms and view only their completed/started forms within the Complete and In Process folders.
9 - Room manager (Paid). Room managers can manage the assigned rooms, invite new users and assign roles below their level.
10 - Editor. Operations with existing files: viewing, editing, form filling, reviewing, commenting.
11 - Content creator. Content creators can create and edit files in the room, but can't manage users, or access settings.

email.description: The email of the user to invite or remove. Mutually exclusive with User ID.

id.description: The ID of the user to invite or remove. Mutually exclusive with User Email.

message.description: The message to use for the invitation.

roomId.description: The ID of the room to invite or remove users from.

name: set_room_security
